summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727 KB obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<target>.zip`, extracts it, and then runs `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])` against an adjacent 727 KB `math_init.js` bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, numeric string-array with a `WV8StW` shuffler) whose behavior is not documented and not inspectable in source form. The declared `main` entry `jest-preset.js` immediately `throw`s with a message redirecting consumers to a different package, so the package provides no jest configuration; the only functional code path on `npm install` is the alternate-runtime dropper. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque sibling bundle, in a package whose advertised jest-config purpose is absent, matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer at install time under a runtime outside typical Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
